text: Binary per-row flag on the OP's argument text only (current text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly requests or demands that responders/readers change the tone or manner of their replies (e.g. be calm, civil, polite, less angry/emotional/aggressive/hostile), i.e. explicit tone-policing; 0 if the argument is present with no such explicit request. Does not count the OP merely describing their own tone, general discussion of civility, requests to be open-minded or give evidence, quoted/reported requests by others the OP doesn't adopt, or generic subreddit rule mentions unless the OP directly asks commenters to change tone. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform rule discussion is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible). Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
